show.description: “Love Ki Adaalat” is a courtroom drama where justice battles power, manipulation, and emotions. When a poor fruit seller is blamed for an accident caused by a rich man, sharp lawyer Tanvi steps into a morally complex fight. As cases unfold, the courtroom becomes a stage for truth, love, and ethics, exposing how money and influence twist justice—and how courage can challenge it. Watch now.
